Abstract.AbstractText: Solitary plasmacytoma of bone (SBP) tends to progress to multiple myeloma (MM); however, progression to multiple solitary plasmacytomas (MSP) is rare. We report a case of CD138-low MSP with 17p deletion in a patient with relapsed SBP. 17p deletion is associated with a poor outcome in patients with MM, and the low expression of CD138 in myeloma cells is associated with drug resistance and a poor prognosis. The patient was successfully treated with bortezomib plus dexamethasone induction therapy and autologous hematopoietic stem cell transplantation followed by bortezomib maintenance therapy. Consequently, bortezomib treatment was stopped and a stringent complete response has been maintained.
